# Vzorky pre secrets.patterns šablón (t_templates_lint). Formát: <HIT|-><TAB><riadok>.
# HIT = aspoň jeden vzor php-nette šablóny musí zachytiť; - = žiadny vzor žiadnej šablóny nesmie zachytiť.
HIT		password: Pl4inNeonPw
HIT	token: abcd1234efgh5678
HIT	DB_PASSWORD=EnvPlainPw99
HIT	  MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ComposePw77
HIT	password: s3cr3t-Pass.word!
-	password: %env.DB_PASS%
-	password: null
-	password: ${DB_PASS}
-	foo(password: $pwd)
-	'password' => $pwd,
-	$token = $this->getToken();
-	token: Tokens\Generator
-	tokenStorage: App\Security\TokenStorage
-	tokenTtl: 86400000
-	token = get_token()
-	secret: [a, b]
